summary: Tested admin dashboard ('Обзор') tab, page-transition regression across public routes, skeleton loaders on catalog/orders. Backend dashboard endpoint fully verified (5/5 pytest pass). Navigation NOT broken by AnimatePresence wrapper - all routes render content. Admin dashboard renders all required testids and 14-bar chart. Found 1 bug: KPI cards navigate to non-existent 'orders' tab.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Всего заказов', 'Ожидают оплаты', 'В обработке' calls onNavigate('orders'), but tabOrder/tabConfig has no 'orders' tab (it contains: overview, products, warehouse, bonus, payments, crm, marketing, logs, settings). After click, the previously active 'Обзор' tab loses active state and no tab becomes active (Radix tab value 'orders' is invalid). Admin orders are actually on a separate route /admin/orders.

action_items: Fix KPI navigation in AdminDashboard.js: either navigate('/admin/orders') via react-router for the three Orders-related KPI cards, OR add an 'orders' tab to AdminPage.js tabOrder/tabConfig (with same migration logic that adds it for existing localStorage). The 'Склад →' button already works correctly because 'warehouse' is in tabOrder.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js is 2000+ lines — should be split into smaller tab-level modules (most tabs already extracted to /components/admin, but the products/orders/users state and handlers still live here).

AdminDashboard onNavigate contract is inconsistent: it uses tab IDs ('warehouse') for some buttons and a non-existent tab name ('orders') for others. Consider unifying as react-router navigate paths OR strictly tab IDs.
AnimatePresence + motion.div keyed by location.pathname inside Routes works correctly here, but be aware: exit animation may briefly delay focus management; verified no blank pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/admin/dashboard verified via pytest (iter80_results.xml). Frontend page transition wrapper does NOT break any route. Catalog skeleton selector [data-testid='loading'] exists but loads too fast to capture in automation — code is correct. Orders skeleton [data-testid='orders-loading'] confirmed visible with 4 placeholders. Main outstanding issue: KPI cards in AdminDashboard navigate to non-existent 'orders' tab — main agent must decide between adding an orders tab or routing to /admin/orders.
rca of the issue: AdminDashboard.js lines 83-85 use onNavigate('orders') for 3 KPI cards. AdminPage.js defaultTabOrder is ['overview','products','warehouse','bonus','payments','crm','marketing','logs','settings'] with no 'orders'. setActiveTab('orders') leaves Radix Tabs without a matching TabsTrigger/TabsContent, so the previously active 'Обзор' tab is deactivated and no panel is shown. Fix: either (a) AdminDashboard receives a navigate prop and uses navigate('/admin/orders'), or (b) add an 'orders' entry to tabOrder + tabConfig in AdminPage.js plus a <TabsContent value='orders'> rendering AdminOrdersPage.
